title: A Breakdown of Facebook Ad Types

facts.fact: Facebook has seven basic ad formats, which can be combined into many ad types aimed at different advertising objectives.
facts.quote: There are only seven basic ad formats, but with these seven, you can design a huge number of ad types aimed at different advertising objectives.

facts.fact: Facebook slideshow ads are made up of 3 to 10 images or a single video that plays in a slideshow.
facts.quote: Slideshow ads](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/149759192130274?id=603833089963720&helpref=search&sr=1&query=slideshow%20ads) are made up of 3 to 10 images or a single video

facts.fact: According to the article, Facebook slideshow ads use five times less data than video ads, which is why they are intended for markets with limited internet connections.
facts.unit: times less data than video ads
facts.quote: These ads are the little cousin to video ads because they use[five times less data](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/slideshow-ad-format) and are intended to be used in markets

facts.fact: Facebook suggests keeping video ads short, at less than 15 seconds.
facts.quote: Keep your videos short (Facebook suggests less than 15 seconds).

facts.fact: Instant Experience ads are mobile-only interactive ads, formerly called Canvas Ads, that let users engage with content on Facebook.
facts.quote: Instant Experience ads](https://www.facebook.com/micro_site/url/...) (formerly Canvas Ads) are a mobile-only interactive ad that lets users engage with your content on Facebook.

facts.fact: The article states that Instant Experience ads load 10 times faster than standard mobile web applications.
facts.unit: times faster than standard mobile web applications
facts.quote: Instant Experience ads also load 10 times faster than standard mobile web applications!

facts.fact: Facebook recommends using five to seven components (images, videos, etc.) in Instant Experience ads because these get more engagement.
facts.quote: Facebook recommends that you use five to seven components (images, videos, etc.) in your ad as these get more engagement.

facts.fact: Facebook ad types are the ad formats tied to Facebook's campaign objectives, such as brand awareness, conversions, or leads.
facts.quote: Each of these objectives has a corresponding ad designed to accomplish that goal; these are called ad types.

facts.fact: Facebook advertisers can create ads in two places: the Facebook Page and the Ads Manager.
facts.quote: With Facebook advertising, you can create ads in two places:

facts.fact: Not all Facebook ad types can be created from a Facebook Page; some must be made in Ads Manager.
facts.quote: You cannot create all ads from your Facebook Page, but you can create:

facts.fact: A Boosted Post looks like an ordinary Facebook post and carries a Sponsored label at the top.
facts.quote: The Boosted Post will look exactly like an ordinary Facebook post, with a **Sponsored** note on top of the ad.

facts.fact: Collection ads let Facebook's algorithms choose which products from the advertiser's catalog are shown to each user.
facts.quote: Let Facebook algorithms decide which products from your catalog are included for each specific user.

facts.fact: Website Purchases ads require the Facebook pixel to be set up first so it can collect the needed data.

facts.fact: Automated ads use AI to help advertisers with targeting, placements, and ad budget.
facts.quote: using AI to help you get the most out of your targeting, placements, and ad budget.

facts.fact: Messenger ads appear in the main tab of Facebook Messenger, where users chat with friends, and users can click to start a conversation with the Page.
facts.quote: Messenger ads appear in the main tab of Facebook messenger, where people spend time chatting with friends.

facts.fact: AdEspresso recommends a Facebook ad image size of 1,200 x 628 pixels.
facts.quote: Recommended image size: 1,200 x 628 pixels

facts.fact: AdEspresso lists a minimum Facebook ad image width of 254 x 133.
facts.quote: Minimum width 254 x 133

facts.fact: AdEspresso lists an image ratio of 1.9:1 for Facebook ad images.
facts.quote: Image ratio: 1.9:1

facts.fact: AdEspresso lists a Facebook ad text length of 125 characters.
facts.quote: Text: 125 characters

facts.fact: AdEspresso lists a Facebook ad headline length of 25 characters.
facts.quote: Headline: 25 characters

facts.fact: AdEspresso lists a Facebook ad description length of 30 characters.
facts.quote: Description: 30 characters

facts.fact: According to AdEspresso, custom audiences and catalogs must be created through Ads Manager rather than from a Facebook Page.
facts.quote: if you want to create custom audiences or catalogs, that’ll need to be done through Ads Manager

facts.fact: AdEspresso defines a Facebook lead ad as an ad with an Instant Form attached to it.
facts.quote: is an ad with an Instant Form attached to it so that you can learn valuable information about future potential customers.

facts.fact: AdEspresso describes a Facebook dynamic creative ad as one where the advertiser provides multiple ad creatives, CTAs and copy sets that Facebook mixes and matches to target each reader.
facts.quote: give Facebook multiple ad creatives, CTAs and copy sets that it can then mix-and-match to target each individual reader.

facts.fact: Facebook dynamic ads target users based on their past actions or inactions on the advertiser's website.
facts.quote: They target users based on past actions (or inactions) on your website with a perfectly timed ad.

facts.fact: To run Facebook dynamic ads, the advertiser uploads a product catalog to Facebook and checks that the pixel is installed correctly on its site.
facts.quote: All you have to do is upload your product catalog to Facebook and double-check that your pixel is installed correctly on your site.

facts.fact: Facebook mobile app ads are displayed only on the mobile News Feed.
facts.quote: This ad is displayed only on the mobile News Feed.

facts.fact: When a user clicks the Install call-to-action on a Facebook mobile app ad, the App Store opens immediately.
facts.quote: When users click the **Install** CTA on your ad, the App Store will immediately pop up.
